summary: The CAS-ANSO Scholarship funds international students for a master's or PhD at the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) or the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS), with research at institutes of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. Tuition is waived, and it pays 3,000 CNY a month for a master's or 6,000 or 7,000 CNY for a PhD, with health insurance and one flight to China. The 2027 call opened on 17 November 2026 and closes on 28 February 2027.
meta_title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship 2027: funded master's and PhD in China
meta_description: CAS-ANSO 2027: tuition waived and 3,000 to 7,000 CNY a month for a master's or PhD at USTC or UCAS. Non-Chinese citizens, apply by 28 Feb 2027.
covers: A tuition waiver and an application fee waiver.
A monthly stipend of 3,000 CNY for a master's, for up to 36 months.
A monthly stipend of 6,000 or 7,000 CNY for a PhD, depending on whether you pass the university's qualification test, for up to 48 months.
Health insurance, one international trip from your home country to China and a one-time visa or residence permit allowance.
eligibility: Any nationality, as long as you do not hold Chinese citizenship.
Born on or after 1 January 1997 for a master's, or on or after 1 January 1992 for a PhD.
Meeting USTC's or UCAS's admission criteria for international students.
Not already enrolled in a master's in China (for the master's track) or a PhD in China (for the PhD track).
how_to_apply: Choose USTC or UCAS. Applying to both for this scholarship is not allowed.
Apply for your master's or PhD through the USTC admission portal (isa.ustc.edu.cn) or the UCAS portal (is.ucas.ac.cn).
Select the CAS-ANSO Scholarship in the application. For the ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD option, tick its box as well.
Make sure you and your referees have submitted everything by 28 February 2027, Beijing time.
watch_out: The age limits are firm: born on or after 1 January 1997 for a master's and 1 January 1992 for a PhD.
You cannot take on other jobs or assignments while you hold the scholarship.
If you are already in China when you apply, the travel allowance is not paid.
ANSO gives no award count for 2027; each year it funds 100 to 200 master's and 300 PhD students.
costs: 3,000 CNY a month (master's) or 6,000 to 7,000 CNY (PhD)
One trip, paid by the scholarship
documents: The USTC or UCAS online application, with the CAS-ANSO Scholarship selected.
Reference letters, which your referees must submit by 28 February 2027.
The transcripts, certificates and other documents your chosen programme asks for.

faq.q: When is the CAS-ANSO Scholarship 2027 deadline?
faq.a: 28 February 2027, Beijing time, for both applicants and referees. The call opened on 17 November 2026.

faq.q: How much does the CAS-ANSO Scholarship pay?
faq.a: Tuition is waived, and the stipend is 3,000 CNY a month for a master's or 6,000 or 7,000 CNY a month for a PhD, with health insurance and one flight to China.
Anyone who does not hold Chinese citizenship, speaks English or Chinese well and meets the age limits: born on or after 1 January 1997 for a master's, or 1 January 1992 for a PhD.
